title: Time Jump: 1:00 — System Isolation and Standdown

fields.narration: It is now 10:00. The interference has spread to the RTK base and to the GCS-02 radio. UAS-11 no longer answers the ground station in any flight mode, and its true position is unknown. All flying at Birch Hollow Range has stopped while the incident is worked.
worldState: All flights at the Birch Hollow Range are on indefinite hold.
The RTK base at TP-LFA-RTK1 has lost synchronization with the network; telemetry shows conflicting corrections.
GCS-02’s C2 link remains unpaired and locked in a failed state.
The aircraft's position on DAA-1 now shows a 1.2 km offset from the actual GPS location, with no known origin for the drift.
The 915 MHz channel is now reporting intermittent signal spikes from an unknown source on 915.420 MHz.
UAS-11 is unresponsive to all manual commands from GCS-02 or backup GCS-04.
FOM-2 has been updated to reflect a new status: 'UAS-11 — Uncontrolled, Position Uncertain, Geofence Breach Detected.'

citations.headingPath: FOM › Section 9 › 9.3 GNSS degradation or spoofing suspicion
citations.quote: Signs: satellite count falls while the sky is clear; position jumps; RTK fix lost on both RTK-1 and the aircraft; the home point moves; DAA-1 and the GCS disagree on position. Actions: the RPIC switch
